bibl.title: Papyri and the Social World of the New Testament.
bibl.seg: Sabine R. Huebner, Papyri and the Social World of the New Testament.
Cambridge, Cambridge University Press, 2019, xvi-192 pp., figg. ISBN 978-1-108-45570-1. £18.99.

C.R. par Brent Nongbri, BMCRev < http://bmcr.brynmawr.edu/2020/2020-02-27.html >. - Rodney Caruthers II, BASP 59 (2022) pp. 419-426. - Thomas J. Kraus, TC: A Journal of Biblical Textual Criticism 26 (2021) 3 pp. < http://jbtc.org/v26/TC-2021-Huebner-Kraus.pdf >. - Jutta Henner, BiZ N.F., 66 (2022) pp. 157-159.
bibl.note: 1. Egypt and the social world of the New Testament. - 2. The social milieu of early Christians in Egypt: who were the first readers of the Gospels? - 3. "In those days a decree went out …": the Herodian kingdom and the Augustan provincial census system. - 4. "But these words seemed to them an idle tale": discrimination and the struggle for women's equality in early Christianity. - 5. "The carpenter's son": the family and household of a craftsman. - 6. "In those days Mary set out …": travel by the lower classes in Roman times. - 7. "In that region there were shepherds living in the fields": an occupation on the margins of society. - 8. Afterword. - Notes. Bibliography. Index locorum. General index.
